name: AABB Intersection via Face Traversal
definition: A method to find the entry (front) and exit (back) points of a ray intersecting an Axis-Aligned Bounding Box by testing the ray against each of the six faces of the AABB.
summary: AABB Intersection via Face Traversal finds ray entry and exit points by testing against six decomposed triangle faces, differing from the standard slab method by being less efficient.
